content_sections.heading: BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Full-Time B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc Engineering (4 Years Course) degree from AICTE approved colleges/institutions or a recognized university. Eligible disciplines include: Electronics Electronics & Communication Engineering Electronics & Telecommunication Telecommunication Communication Electronics & Instrumentation Electrical & Electronics Computer Science Computer Science Engineering Information Technology Information Science & Engineering The upper age limit for BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026 is 35 years as on 01 August 2026.

content_sections.heading: BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Experience Requirement
content_sections.text: Candidates should have minimum 04 years of post qualification industrial experience in the relevant field as on 01 August 2026. The experience should be related to areas such as: Database and Software Development Embedded System Development 3D Visual Software Development

content_sections.heading: BEL Senior Engineer 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for the post of Senior Engineer / E-III will be placed in the pay scale of ₹50,000 - 3% - ₹1,60,000 . Apart from the basic pay, selected candidates will receive additional benefits and allowances as per BEL company rules. Dearness Allowance (DA) House Rent Allowance (HRA) Conveyance Allowance Perquisites at 35% of annual basic pay Performance Related Pay Medical Expense Reimbursement Group Insurance Provident Fund (PF) Pension Gratuity (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: BEL Senior Engineer Fixed Term Engagement Details
content_sections.text: The engagement for Senior Engineer will be on a fixed-term basis for a period of 05 years . The tenure may be extended by an additional 02 years based on individual performance and project requirements after completion of five years.

content_sections.heading: BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee should be paid through SBI Collect online mode. Fee once paid will not be refunded.

content_sections.heading: BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026 consists of the following stages: Written Test Interview Candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria and whose applications are accepted will be shortlisted for the Written Test. Candidates qualifying in the Written Test will be called for Interview in the ratio of 1:7 based on merit.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official application link provided by Bharat Electronics Limited. Visit the BEL recruitment application portal. Read the complete recruitment notification carefully. Complete the online registration process. Fill in all required details in the application form. Upload the required documents and certificates. Pay the application fee, if applicable. Submit the application form. Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Important Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates need to upload the following documents while submitting the online application: Recent colour passport size photograph SSLC / SSC / 10th Standard marks card as proof of date of birth Final consolidated degree marks sheet Final Degree / Provisional Degree Certificate CGPA/SGPA/DGPA conversion certificate or percentage proof Caste / Tribe / Community / Disability / EWS certificate (if applicable) Post qualification experience certificates Identity proof such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Driving Licence or Voter ID Detailed write-up on post qualification experience SBI fee payment receipt (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Candidates should possess valid experience certificates from previous/current employers. Experience without supporting documents will not be considered. Changes in submitted application details will not be allowed after submission. Candidates working in Government departments, PSUs or Semi-Government organisations must submit NOC at the time of interview. Candidates should keep their registered email ID and mobile number active for future communication. Written Test and Interview details will be communicated through Email/SMS. BEL reserves the right to modify or cancel the recruitment process if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive conducted by Bharat Electronics Limited for hiring Senior Engineers on a Fixed Term Basis for Export Manufacturing - SBU at Bangalore Complex.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 12 Senior Engineer vacancies are available under BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a Full-Time B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc Engineering (4 Years Course) degree in relevant disciplines from AICTE approved institutions or recognized universities.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years as on 01 August 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per Government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of BEL Senior Engineer 2026?
faq.answer: Selected Senior Engineers will receive a pay scale of ₹50,000 - 3% - ₹1,60,000 along with applicable allowances and benefits.

faq.question: Q6. How much experience is required for BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a minimum of 04 years of post qualification industrial experience in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for BEL Senior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test followed by an Interview.
